diff_summary: Refactored dbms_sql and dbms_mongo to APIRouters with FastAPI Depends injection (get_race_db, get_race_telemetry, get_mongo_db, admin). Folded intermediate assembly lambdas in main.py, mounting routers directly. Preserved backwards-compatible factories, handlers, and re-exported aliases with exact OpenAPI compatibility and route registration uniqueness.

verification.command: APP_ENV=local .venv/bin/pytest -q backend/tests/test_contract_snapshot.py backend/tests/test_route_registration.py backend/tests/test_api.py -k "test_runtime_route_registrations or test_current_openapi" && APP_ENV=local .venv/bin/mypy --strict backend/app && APP_ENV=local .venv/bin/ruff check backend/app && APP_ENV=local .venv/bin/ruff format --check backend/app
